column1: # Vendored external agent skills — single source of truth for coding-agents/vendor/fetch.sh
# Skills listed here are fetched from upstream repos at a PINNED commit and
# written into ../skills/<name>/ (gitignored payload). Only this manifest,
# fetch.sh and README.md are tracked. To update: bump PIN, re-run ./fetch.sh.
# The file is read top-to-bottom: REPO/PIN/LICENSE set the current source for
# the skill lines that follow, so multiple REPO/PIN blocks can coexist.
# Config lines (KEY=value):
REPO=https://github.com/mizchi/skills
LICENSE=MIT (mizchi/skills repo default; no per-skill LICENSE.txt upstream)
# Skill lines: <local-name><TAB><upstream-path>
retrospective-codify
ast-grep-practice
optimizing-descriptions
empirical-prompt-tuning
waxa-eval
# skill-selector / skill-finder were folded into the first-party skill-curation skill.
# Second source: official ast-grep agent skill (authoritative rule reference)
REPO=https://github.com/ast-grep/agent-skill
PIN=577f4d4507678f2c8cee150fae25e6ce309f70b1
LICENSE=none (no LICENSE file upstream; payload is gitignored, not redistributed)
ast-grep
# Third source: obra/superpowers (TDD loop discipline; complements first-party development-style)
REPO=https://github.com/obra/superpowers
PIN=d884ae04edebef577e82ff7c4e143debd0bbec99
LICENSE=MIT
test-driven-development
# Fifth source: Inkdrop's own agent skills (upstream companion to the Inkdrop MCP
# server). Only note-taking is adopted: it documents Inkdrop's markdown dialect
# (code-block attributes, mermaid, KaTeX, inkdrop://note/<id> links) that the
# first-party inbox-capture / weekly-review / monthly-summary skills never state.
# fill-out-template is NOT adopted: it duplicates the first-party plan-doc /
# planning-workflow lane (plans live in .claude/plans/, not in Inkdrop templates).
REPO=https://github.com/inkdropapp/skills
PIN=067b7796649fcd56c0023eb2b5dfee68e984fcbd
LICENSE=none (no LICENSE file upstream; README acknowledges it; payload is gitignored, not redistributed)
note-taking
# Sixth source: mattpocock/skills — relentless planning interview + ADR/glossary.
# grill-with-docs = /grilling + /domain-modeling, so the two entry points
# (grill-me, grill-with-docs, both slash-command-only via disable-model-invocation)
# require the two engine skills (grilling, domain-modeling, both auto-invocable)
# to be vendored alongside. domain-modeling ships ADR-FORMAT.md / CONTEXT-FORMAT.md
# in its dir (copied as-is). The design-doc gap (2-3 approaches / spec self-review /
# scope decomposition, which superpowers/brainstorming would enforce) is left open
# on purpose: absorbed lightly via a design section in the first-party plan-doc
# template; a dedicated design skill is deferred until the need is real.
# Adopted 2026-08-16 by explicit user direction after in-conversation rubric check;
# waxa eval skipped (these are interactive interview skills — the executor eval loop
# is ill-suited to them).
REPO=https://github.com/mattpocock/skills
LICENSE=MIT
grilling
grill-me
grill-with-docs
domain-modeling
